ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro-level ratio; approximately 70% high-intensity (white) pixels to 30% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous areas across the medial and distal surfaces of both lobes. A low-intensity black region is concentrated at the fluke base (peduncle junction) and extends as a thin boundary along the entire trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 12% of the total vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe exhibits a series of low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations. The right lobe exhibits significant, irregular high-amplitude peaks and valleys, particularly a deep jagged indentation near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch transitioning into a broad convex sweep towards the tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, curved linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) located on the right lobe, oriented vertically from the mid-lobe toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation and jagged tissue profile on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal tip, suggesting previous physical trauma or predatory interaction marks.
